ICS 65.100.10FAD 01Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for fenitrothion, emulsifiable concentrates.1.2 Fenitrothion, emulsifiable concentrates may be used for locust control in scheduled desert area and for public health only.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed in Annex A.
